verdict.rationale: GlitchTip says it aims to be Sentry API compatible. It also offers an official CLI for releases, deploys and debug-file uploads, plus a built-in MCP server that can browse, inspect and resolve issues. Together these show meaningful programmatic surface, but nothing documents that every UI action (orgs, teams, alerts, uptime monitors, settings) is reachable via API, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the tried paths. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or comprehensive API reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, documented API coverage of org/team/alert/uptime management, independent corroboration.
